# Code of conduct

We want this project to remain useful, rigorous, and welcoming.

Contributors are expected to:

- discuss people and ideas respectfully;
- give technical criticism with evidence and reproducible examples;
- avoid harassment, personal attacks, discrimination, and disclosure of private information;
- distinguish calendar facts, implementation policies, and interpretive traditions;
- avoid presenting BaZi output as guaranteed medical, legal, financial, or personal outcomes.

Unacceptable behavior may be removed from project spaces. Serious or sensitive concerns can be reported privately to [support@mingora.app](mailto:support@mingora.app).
